Final-outcome re-review: skipping the complete C06 with reason unclear is justified. The corrected outcomes ledger removes all C06 declaration IDs, and the corrected spec contains only C04/C05, so neither an exact-equality surrogate nor a narrowed single-configuration replay comparison is published. Correct here evaluates the conservative skip decision, not the scientific truth of the FLOP magnitude or any executed verdict.
